title: MNV-17: A HIGH-QUALITY PERFORMATIVE MANDARIN DATASET FOR NONVERBAL VOCALIZATION RECOGNITION IN SPEECH
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation of a nonverbal vocalization dataset and its use in benchmarking speech recognition models, including LLM-based architectures like Qwen. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics beyond a standard declaration of ethical data collection procedures.
